artist.bio: Gameboyz is an electronic music duo and production team from Badajoz, Spain, consisting of Xar Lee (Carlos Franco) and Modernphase (Luis Vallespín). Originally founded in 2012 as a trio with former member Da Well (Manuel Maidero), they are known for a sound they describe as "Iberic'n'Roll"—a blend of techno, disco, and house with a rock-and-roll edge. .
